# Language and i18n rules (enforced by tools/guards: L1xx, L2xx)

- **English everywhere by default:** code comments, docstrings, commit messages, PR text,
  docs, ADRs, agent files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.agents/**`).
- **String literals are data** and may use any language (e.g. Unicode test fixtures).
- **Translations** are separate files next to the English source, named
  `<stem>-<LANG><suffix>` with an upper-case ISO 639-1 code: `README-KO.md`,
  `docs/workflow-KO.md`. Supported codes live in `docs/i18n.toml` (`languages`).
- The first line of a translation pins the English revision it was translated from:
  `<!-- i18n: source=README.md source-sha256=<12 hex> -->`.
- Docs listed under `[required]` in `docs/i18n.toml` must ship every listed translation.
- **Changing an English source that has translations:** in the same change either update the
  translation and run `uv run python -m tools.guards i18n-stamp <translation>`, or hand it to
  the `translator` sub-agent. Never stamp a translation you did not actually update.
- Agent-facing files are never translated.
